latestVersion.changelog:
VidMuse AI skill — initial release:

- Instantly create music-synced videos from user-uploaded clips, supporting MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM formats up to 500MB.
- Cloud GPU-powered rendering delivers beat-synced, 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic authentication flow grants 100 free credits with anonymous, token-based access.
- Simple user commands for upload, sync, export, credits, and status.
- Robust error handling and status reporting, including file format validation, session management, and clear workflow feedback.
